rf-ci-alert-sink

values.content:
route:
  receiver: incident-webhook
  group_by: [alertname]
  group_wait: 5s
  group_interval: 10s
  repeat_interval: 1h
receivers:
  - name: incident-webhook
    webhook_configs:
      - url: http://alert-sink:8080/
        send_resolved: true

# Згенеровано Terraform (модуль monitoring). Пороги задаються змінними модуля.
groups:
  - name: roomflow-infrastructure
    rules:
      - alert: InstanceDown
        expr: up{job="roomflow"} == 0
        for: 10s
        labels: { severity: critical }
        annotations:
          summary: "Репліка {{ $labels.instance }} ({{ $labels.color }}) недоступна"
      - alert: ReplicaGroupDegraded
        expr: count by (color) (up{job="roomflow"} == 1) < 2
        for: 15s
        labels: { severity: warning }
        annotations:
          summary: "У групі {{ $labels.color }} менше двох здорових реплік"
      - alert: HighErrorRate
        expr: sum(rate(roomflow_http_requests_total{code=~"5.."}[1m])) / sum(rate(roomflow_http_requests_total[1m])) > 0.05
        for: 30s
        labels: { severity: critical }
        annotations:
          summary: "Частка помилок 5xx перевищує 0.05"
      - alert: HighLatencyP95
        expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(roomflow_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[1m]))) > 0.5
        for: 30s
        labels: { severity: warning }
        annotations:
          summary: "p95 затримки перевищує 0.5 с"

# Згенеровано Terraform (модуль monitoring).
global:
  scrape_interval: 5s
  scrape_timeout: 4s
  evaluation_interval: 5s

rule_files: [/etc/rf/alerts.yml]

alerting:
  alertmanagers:
    - static_configs:
        - targets: ["alertmanager:9093"]

scrape_configs:
  - job_name: roomflow
    dns_sd_configs:
      - names: ["app-blue","app-green"]
        type: A
        port: 8080
        refresh_interval: 5s
    relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__meta_dns_name]
        regex: app-(.*)
        target_label: color
  - job_name: prometheus
    static_configs:
      - targets: ["localhost:9090"]
